text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Gaaaaah! I can't believe I didn't win!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: So what?! I wanted to get first!
choice_data_list: でも『桜花賞』には行ける

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
This isn't nearly enough! Next time I'm
going to
get the gold for sure!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
choice_data_list: でもウオッカには勝った

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
But there's no fun in just beating her
once. I need
to totally wipe the floor
with her!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Because I have to! Why is my own trainer
babying
me so much?!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
You should be angrier! More frustrated!
More
determined never to let anyone
else steal the
number one spot again!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
We need to start training as soon as
we're back!
I'm going to iron out every
last wrinkle!
